en: Would you believe that in my darkest hour, at the apex of my being, I failed.$B$BAs I fled from the wanton destruction of the forces that overwhelmed us, the only sounds I could hear were the screams of my soldiers and the rapid beat of my own heart.$B$BA short while later, I returned to the Blasted Lands in hopes of rescuing my men and restoring my honor. Instead I was captured and beaten until dead.$B$BWhat I found out during my inquisition and subsequent torture was horrifying.
Have you freed Drull yet? I don't know where he's being held.

War is a bloody, messy ordeal full of pain, suffering and death. But those that survive come back with a new respect for life. Not to mention a collection of stories to tell around the bar, full of bravery and courage. So tell me $g lad : lass;, are you here to make some stories? or just to hear some of mine?
Your attacks are weak!  Go practice on some rabbits and come back when you're stronger.
Warriors, I know you can hit harder than that! Lets see it!
Give me the beacon, Slidore! Also, you still stink!

Hail, young warrior. Our journey together shall take many strides, but this step is no less important than the others.

Before you lies the arena. In it, it matters not who you call mother or whether you wield sword or mace. All are equal, and all learn to sharpen their horns in direct combat.

Enter our space, and learn through combat. You may face any of these novices, or any other willing adversary. I care not which.
I only teach students who have already mastered the basics. You must seek out the night elf Darianna in the Craftsmen's Terrace of Darnassus. Her skills will be a perfect complement to yours.
I'm ready to fly, Commander. Just give the word and I'll be on their base like trogg on rock.
Enough! I will talk. Put your weapons away, it is not with me that you have quarrel with.
%s jumps in fright!
Duncan's Textiles employs one of the finest tailors in Stormwind, Georgio Bolero. Look for the shop over in the Mage Quarter.
Huh? What dat?

Ho there, traveler! New to town? Well, once you get settled in come see me if you'd like some work. I've been working overtime preparing for the Festival of Winds and I'll take all the help I can get keeping the larders full!
This is all very interesting but what is it that you want?
The Alliance has gathered $1776W resources, and is near victory!

Do not presume to speak to me as though you are my equal, $c. Sylvanas is my queen, and I will do as she bids.$B$BIf you do not show the proper respect, I assure you, we can find a more than suitable place for you in the Nether.$B$BBut there is no reason we cannot have words if you wish to aid the Dark Lady...

Captain Balinda Stonehearth leads the front line Alliance forces.  She is based in the Stonehearth Outpost, in the northern section of the Field of Strife.$B$BBalinda is currently in Stonehearth Outpost.
You need to be friendly with the trolls of the Darkspear tribe before I will teach you a riding skill, $c.
Before the Scourge came, I had a great business.  I bought and sold everything.  Everything!$B$BAnd my prices were INSANE!$B$BJust ask anyone.  Anyone who's not dead.
Elves in Warsong Gulch make crunchy sound. You crunch them good. Talk to Kurden Bloodclaw in Royal Quarter.
I would show my liege the beast's ear and claim the beast's death as my own - after all, I did slay it.  I would then offer some of the reward to the destitute knight to help his family.
I'm back where I started.
I thank you, $n.  My associates who will do great things with these...
Alright. Where?
The pleasure is mine, madam. Might I ask what it is that you are doing here?
He must be overwhelmed with work at the Monastery. But still, he should have returned by now.
You lack tact, Commander. This is not surprising. However, you are right in that the Horde will be forced to act. But not just the Horde. They already come - heroes from across the world.
Oh, darn...
I'll finish you off for good this time!
This songflower plant stands out as a rock in the sea of corruption that is Felwood. Its petals have a powerful fragrance that bolsters your spirits and strengthens your resolve.

It's good to have veterans like you in Alterac Valley, $n.  Our supplies are too low to launch a ground assault through Alterac Valley... speak with our quartermaster - he'll tell you how to increase our supply base.
Soldiers of Kalimdor, defend the base!
The Ruins of Eldarath.
Please, leave this place, $n. You know nothing of what troubles us...
and Bone.
My daddy says that in the ocean, there are fish so big they could swallow a whole ship.
